title: 25 · kali_tongue · Kali's Tongue
lines: Why is the goddess standing on Shiva,
It is the moment she realised whose chest that was.
There was a demon named Raktabija.
Every drop of his blood that touched the ground became another of him.
she let out the one thing that could finish it.
Kali drank every drop before it could fall.
Until there were no more of him.
The rage that saved the world was now breaking it.
No one dared stand in her way.
He lay down in her path.
Her foot came down on his chest.
She bit her tongue. The sword dropped. The dance ended.
When your anger has done its work, let love stop you. That is sadhana.
